description:
This torrent is an updated version of Kasumeido's torrent (https://sukebei.nyaa.si/view/3063397).
It contains the latest vanilla versions of Custom Maid 3D 2 (ver. 1.66) and Custom Order Maid 3D 2 (ver. 2.14.0) with all of each game's DLC preinstalled. Does not contain any mods, translations or plugins.

===Installation===

1. Set your computer's locale to Japanese.
2. Do not download or install to the default "Downloads" folder because the path will most likely be too long and will cause all sorts of issues when trying to update or install new DLC. The "Downloads" folder in Windows has some restrictions for security reasons.
Move or copy the KISS folder to the path where you want the game to be installed. Something like "D:\Games\" is good.
3. Within each game's folder is a respective batch file (set_install_directory.bat) that can be used to add its install information to your registry. This allows you to install future updates and DLC.
